FROM ast_device WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND project_id = #{query.projectId} AND deleted = b'0' AND shipment_time IS NOT NULL AND sn IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(sn) <> ''
AND (sn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR product_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR product_model LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
